# protogx

> Inspect a protocol state machine for deadlocks, unhandled messages and unreachable states. Reports problems with stable codes and exit codes, and writes an annotated storyboard.

protogx is one of the `gxkit` agent-native review tools. Declare states,
transitions and the messages that drive them; `protogx inspect` proves every
state is reachable, that a terminal state is reachable from everywhere, and that
no declared message or awaited response is unhandled.

## Install

```sh
uvx --from "git+https://github.com/nekomario28/gxkit#subdirectory=packages/protogx" protogx --help
uv tool install ./packages/protogx      # from a clone
```

Needs Python 3.10+ and Pillow.

## Use

```sh
protogx inspect proto.py            # report + storyboard, exit 1 on any error
protogx inspect proto.py --json
protogx inspect proto.py --no-storyboard
protogx render  proto.py -o proto.png
```

A protocol file defines `protocol` (a `Protocol`) or module-level `STATES` /
`TRANSITIONS` / `START` / `TERMINAL` / `MESSAGES` / `REQUESTS` / `RESPONSES`.

## Checks

error: `no-start`, `unknown-state`, `unknown-message`, `unhandled-message`,
`nondeterministic`, `deadlock`, `no-exit`, `unreachable-state`, `no-terminal`.
warn: `missing-response`.
info: `cycle`.

Full documentation is in `README.md`.
